meta.package: Peng-Robinson, rigorous (non-ideal) flash, inside-out, liquid volume from the EOS without Peneloux, DWSIM propane constants, R = 8.314
meta.flowsheet: 1_evap_out (sat. vapor, 2.45 bar, 1 mol/s propane) -> C-1 -> CD-1 -> V-1 -> EV-1 -> 5_evap_out

constants_note: Vc = 0.2 m3/kmol = 200 cm3/mol. IG formation (25 C): H -2373.93 kJ/kg, G -553.116 kJ/kg, S -6.10705 kJ/(kg K); MW 44.0956.

cp.equation: Cp = A + exp(B/T + C + D*T + E*T^2), J/(kmol K), T in K

evaporator.note: DWSIM specifies 253 K, 0.005 K above its own dew point; thermo-sim takes the outlet to saturated vapor (V_frac=1).

saturation.vapor_pressure_equation: exp(A + B/T + C ln T + D T^E), Pa
saturation.note: DWSIM places pure-component saturation points with this correlation (Tsat(2.45 bar) = 252.9946 K, Tsat(12.5 bar) = 308.9471 K), not with the EOS (253.2214 K, 309.1735 K).
